title: ReplayEvidence
description: Deterministic-replay attestation — records that a run was replayed from a fixed seed and produced a matching output, proving determinism. Carries the AEP envelope fields (schema_version, created_at_ms) plus replay-specific keys.

trace_id.description: Optional correlation ID linking related evidence records

created_at_ms.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the record was created

run_id.description: Identifier of the run being attested for deterministic replay

seed.description: The deterministic seed the run was replayed with

input_digests.description: Content digests of every input consumed by the replayed run, in a stable order

output_digest.description: Content digest of the replayed run's output; a match across replays proves determinism

engine_version.description: Version of the execution engine/runtime that performed the replay

signature.description: Optional tamper-evident signature over the record content
